description: CR 601.2a the spell is already on the stack when CR 601.2c announces its targets
note: CR 601.2a moves the card to the stack FIRST, before CR 601.2b's modes and cost and CR 601.2c's targets, so the object a player announces targets for is the spell on the stack and not the card in hand. CR 400.7 makes them two objects: the hand card keeps its label, so the target prompt naming its source as the unlabelled Lightning Bolt and not $bolt is the claim that CR 601.2a ran first.
